items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: It was Sidney or Beason, Bill Beason.

ctx.x: get a chance to make a little bread, I had to pay it out for something, you know.

The first Sunday we played there, the first week, I had to play the tango compositions. And I had never had no dealings with tangos, but my brother and Prince Robinson did, because they had been in New York, and they played dancing schools and they knew all about that. I didn't even know how to start it off, to tell you the truth. So Joe said, "Just give us a downbeat, we'll take it," you know. Let's see, I think Sidney Catlett was playing drums with me at first, when we first went in there. Yeah, I'm pretty sure…
